shots.image: Photorealistic vertical full-body shot of a slim Cornish Rex cat with a short, tightly wavy cream-and-apricot coat with soft faint tabby stripes, very large rounded ears, a small wedge-shaped face and bright copper-amber eyes, standing upright on its hind legs in the middle of an empty cobblestone path at a cosy winter night market, both front paws tucked together under its chin, body leaning slightly to one side mid-sway, warm golden string lights overhead, softly blurred wooden market stalls with plain cream canvas awnings in the background, gentle steam rising from a stall, a few small snowflakes in the air, the whole cat clearly visible and centered, vertical composition
shots.motion: From the very first frame the Cornish Rex cat sways side to side on its hind legs to the beat, both front paws tucked under its chin: lean left, lean right, lean left, lean right, its big ears bobbing gently and its head tilting with each sway. Warm string lights twinkle, steam drifts up from the market stall and small snowflakes float down. The cat stays fully in frame with four normal legs the whole time. Photorealistic, smooth natural motion, static camera.

shots.edit: Keep exactly the same slim Cornish Rex cat with the short tightly wavy cream-and-apricot coat, faint tabby stripes, very large rounded ears, same fur pattern, face and eye color. Same winter night market path, same string lights and stalls. Now the cat strikes a sweet final pose: still standing upright on its hind legs, both front paws pressed softly against its cheeks, head tilted to one side, eyes in a happy half-closed squint, mouth closed, looking at the camera. Photorealistic, vertical composition.
shots.motion: From the very first frame the Cornish Rex cat holds its paws on its cheeks and bobs its tilted head gently to the beat, a small sway left and right, then gives one slow happy blink at the camera. Warm string lights twinkle, steam drifts from the stall and small snowflakes keep falling. The cat stays fully in frame with four normal legs the whole time. Photorealistic, smooth natural motion, static camera.

trend.why_now: A swaying dance done with hands tucked under the chin took off on TikTok in early November 2026. Pets doing cute dance formats are also all over this week's trend roundups, so a cat doing its own version of the chin sway fits what's popular right now.
trend.pattern: The cat is already mid-dance in the first second: a side-to-side sway with its paws tucked under its chin. Shot 2 lands on an extra-sweet pose with paws on its cheeks and a head tilt. The caption is about the relatable 'cute part of the song' moment. We don't use the trend's song, anime clip or catchphrase.
